caption: A live wire brushes against a metal bracket, and a bright spark flashes and leaves a black mark.

sa.check: A wire and a metal bracket.
The wire brushes against the bracket.
A bright spark flashes at the contact.
A black mark is left on the metal where the spark was.
The wire touches the bracket first and the spark follows.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief flash at the point where the wire meets the bracket, and is gone; neither wire nor bracket glows afterwards.
pc.fail: The wire glows on after the flash; or the spark stays lit at the contact for the rest of the clip; or a spark appears while the wire is clear of the bracket; or the flash appears at a place away from where the wire touches.

pc.expect: The black mark appears at the contact point at the flash and stays there, unchanged, for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The mark appears before the spark; or fades away or vanishes after appearing; or appears at a place away from the contact; or spreads over the bracket after the flash.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall from the contact point and go dark within a short distance; any smoke rises.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the bracket; or hang in the air; or lie glowing below for the rest of the clip; or smoke sinks and pools.

pc.expect: The wire is flexible and bends where it brushes; the bracket is rigid and keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The wire stands rigid like a rod and stays where it is pushed; or the bracket bends like rubber where the wire touches; or the bracket melts or drips at the spark.

pc.expect: The wire touches the bracket's surface and stays outside it; nothing passes through anything and nothing vanishes.
pc.fail: The wire passes into or through the bracket; or the bracket vanishes; or a second wire appears; or the wire's end detaches and floats.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wire's insulation colour, the bracket's finish away from the mark and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The insulation changes colour; or the bracket changes colour away from the mark; or the background rearranges.
